description:
The Huffy Glimmer 16" Kids Bike brings color, confidence, and fun to every adventure. With its bright amethyst frame, holographic graphics, and playful details, this bike turns neighborhood rides into exciting moments kids will look forward to again and again.
Designed for kids ages 4 to 6, the Glimmer delivers a comfortable fit that helps young riders build confidence on two wheels. Removable training wheels provide extra stability while learning, while the simple single-speed design keeps riding easy and enjoyable as skills continue to grow.
A rear coaster brake and front hand brake give riders dependable stopping power as they gain confidence. The padded saddle and soft mushroom-style grips add comfort on every ride, while colorful streamers and a matching handlebar bag bring extra personality and fun wherever the adventure leads.

components.description: Dual braking system: Rear coaster brake and front hand brake.
